name: Maintenance Delegation 17
definition: Information on the delegation of a maintenance action or maintenance function.

Response.name: Response
Response.definition: Response of the MTM to the delegation of the maintenance service.

ResponseReason.name: Response Reason
ResponseReason.definition: Reason of the response of the MTM.

POISubset.name: POI Subset
POISubset.definition: Subset of the terminal estate for the delegated actions, for instance for pilot or key deactivation). The subset may be expressed as a list of POI or terminal estate subset identifier.

DelegationScopeIdentification.name: Delegation Scope Identification
DelegationScopeIdentification.definition: Identifies the delegation scope assigned by the MTM.

DelegationScopeDefinition.name: Delegation Scope Definition
DelegationScopeDefinition.definition: This element contains all information relevant to the DelegationScopeIdentification. The format of this element is out of scope of this definition.

DelegationProof.name: Delegation Proof
DelegationProof.definition: Contains the necessary information to secure the management of the Delegation. The format of this element is out of scope of this definition.

POIIdentificationAssociation.name: POI Identification Association
POIIdentificationAssociation.definition: Association of the TM identifier and the MTM identifier of a POI.
